views.css: :root{color-scheme:light dark}body{background:light-dark(#fff,#202420);color:light-dark(#253329,#e4ece6);font:15px system-ui}main{max-width:900px;margin:auto;padding:40px}h1{font:600 42px/1.15 Georgia,serif;margin:14px 0}p{line-height:1.7;color:light-dark(#627166,#abbcaf)}.eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:700;color:light-dark(#366b4c,#9acd9e)}input{accent-color:light-dark(#366b4c,#9acd9e)}.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid light-dark(#dde5df,#3a473e)}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:18px}.card{background:light-dark(#f3f6f1,#2b342b);border-radius:12px;padding:24px}.metric{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:30px 0 12px}.metric strong{font:36px Georgia,serif}input[type=range]{width:100%}input[type=number]{width:90px;background:transparent;color:inherit;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:5px;padding:7px;font:inherit}svg{width:100%;height:auto}.point{fill:light-dark(#366b4c,#9acd9e)}@media(max-width:480px){main{padding:22px}h1{font-size:32px}}.notebook{height:320px;max-width:230px;margin:20px auto;background:light-dark(#38634c,#6a9477);border-radius:5px 16px 16px 5px;box-shadow:inset 12px 0 0 light-dark(#294c38,#547a5d),8px 10px 0 light-dark(#dde4d9,#374536)}
